summary: Master community-led program design using IAP2 and ABCD frameworks. Learn to build inclusive, sustainable programs that drive social impact and ESG results.
lede: Community-led program design training focuses on involving community members in project planning, implementation and evaluation. It is for program and social-impact practitioners who need to align organizational goals with community priorities. Participants practice participatory needs and asset assessments, analyze stakeholders and power dynamics, and develop community-informed program strategies with feedback and monitoring approaches.
audienceIntro: This intermediate-level course is essential for professionals who manage the intersection of organizational strategy and community impact.
modules: Digital Engagement and AI in Community Design
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 2-3 years of experience in program management, community development, or social impact roles. Familiarity with basic project management cycles is recommended. No prior experience with specific digital engagement tools is required, as these will be introduced during the course.
